data.gender_notes: Taliyah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Taliyah means 'Dew from the Lord'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word taliah, which means 'dew' or 'gentle rain from God'. In the Bible, Taliyah is mentioned in 2 Chronicles 35:2, where it refers to the daughter of King Josiah. The name Taliyah carries the meaning “Dew from the Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Taliyah usually hope their child will grow to embody dew from the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
